notes: GeoTalk 3.1.0: NEW — Random Chat: tap Find on the Chats tab and connect instantly with a random GeoTalk user anywhere (chat + voice, Skip to the next person anytime, add them as a contact if you click). NEW — voice messages in internet chats: tap the mic, record up to 3 minutes, send; tap to play on the other side, even after being offline. Plus smoother transitions and polish throughout. Free live internet + Bluetooth voice calls, internet messaging and in-app updates included.
